text:
Alex: quick idea — run a timeboxed preemptible buy window + concurrency cap per-region to reduce mass-evictions during flaps. keep it simple: small bursts instead of always-on bidding.
Priya: +1. do you mean schedule buys only in X-minute windows and limit concurrent launches? how do we pick window size?
Alex: yes. e.g., 3x 5-min windows every hour, staggered across regions so not all pools refresh simultaneously. cap concurrent boots to 15% of pool.
Sam: what about price vs capacity optimization? we still need cheap hours.
Priya: mix: 70% capacity-optimized for stability, 30% price-optimized during low-usage windows. that way we avoid mass preempts but catch cheaper spots.
Maria: we need a safe failover path. if eviction rate > 5% in a window, auto-reduce price-optimized share to 0 and extend cooldown.
Alex: right — propose a simple state machine: NORMAL -> HIGH_EVICTION -> COOLDOWN. HIGH_EVICTION triggers cap and zero-price-optimized.
Sam: +1. also add a buyback throttle so we don't immediately refill everything when eviction drops. exponential backing-off helps.
Priya: suggested monitoring signals: eviction_rate, avg_relaunch_latency, launch_fail_rate, cost_per_gpu_hour. tie to SLO policy.
Maria: here's a quick example config for the controller (pseudo-yaml):

```
window_minutes: 5
windows_per_hour: 3
cap_concurrency_percent: 15
price_optimized_share: 30
capacity_optimized_share: 70
eviction_rate_threshold_pct: 5
cooldown_minutes: 30
buyback_backoff: [1m,5m,15m]
```

Sam: can we simulate on last 30 days of events? want to see regressed cost and availability.
Alex: I'll run a sim job next week; need to know which regions to prioritize. suggestion: us-west1, eu-west1, asia-south1 staggered windows.
Priya: also annotate instance families — keep critical pools on A100/GPU-ampere capacity-optimized; opportunistic on older cards.
Maria: ops-oncall: add a circuit breaker to stop all preemptible buys if control-plane latency spikes > 200ms for 2m.
InfraBot: scheduled job created: `preemptible-sim-run-2026-03-25` — will run with params from Alex. (job id 0a3f)
Sam: nice. one more ask — expose a quick toggle in the console to flip price-optimized share for emergency.
Alex: agree; UI toggle + API override. make the override audit-logged.
Priya: I'll draft a short runbook for oncall: when to flip, what metrics to watch, and rollback steps.
Maria: cool. if sim looks good, we can pilot in us-west1 next Thursday low-traffic window.
Alex: thanks all. cc @Priya @Sam — I'll share sim results and a follow-up PR for the controller config.
